reason: The prose drawings of PL2 and PL3 are chemically consistent with the source constraints: PL2 uses same-handed diacylglycerophosphate arms linked by 1,3-propanediol, and PL3 is the monoanionic ethyl phosphodiester with one stereogenic glycerol centre. However, the Lean theorems do not substantively derive several essential source properties from the explicit graphs. Formula, bond-count, and hydrolysis claims are proved using separately precomputed constants with no graph-to-formula or graph-cleavage relation; PL2 is not formally shown to be more symmetrical than PL1; and chirality is reduced to inequality after flipping an unconstrained handedness tag. The default project build also fails because IChO2026Problems/All.lean is missing.

coverage.evidence: Source page Q5-4 requires a neutral 254-bond, chiral PL2 more symmetrical than PL1, hydrolysing to four RCOOH, two H3PO4, Z, and two glycerols, with Z containing only C/H/O and resisting H2. The candidate graph chemically depicts a valid same-handed bis(phosphatidyl) 1,3-propanediol structure. Nevertheless, totalBondOrder and hydrolysisBalance concern the independent constants pl2Formula and fattyAcid rather than m or its graph; Z formula and reactivity are not linked to its graph; no comparison with PL1 proves greater symmetry; and IsEnantiomericPair only flips a free Handedness tag.

The source hydrolysis drawing gives two RCOOH, H3PO4, ethanol, and glycerol and states physiological charge and an enantiomeric pair. The candidate graph has the corresponding chemically correct ethyl phosphodiester connectivity, two R residues, phosphate O−, and a stereogenic glycerol centre. But its hydrolysis balance uses an independent precomputed pl3NeutralFormula rather than graph cleavage, its physiological charge is assigned definitionally without a chemical-state relation, and enantiomerism is represented only by changing an unconstrained tag.

unsupported_assumptions: fattyAcid is unconditionally defined as C18H32O2; fatty_acid_counts_derived proves this only from two premises that are never established or used to derive that definition.
pl1Formula, pl2Formula, pl3NeutralFormula, and pl3PhysiologicalFormula are result-shaped constants not proved to be the formulas of the explicit molecular drawings.
Elemental formula balance is treated as establishing the specified hydrolysis connectivity, although no relation between graph bond cleavage and the product structures is formalized.
An all-single-bond heavy-atom list is treated as establishing Z's catalytic-H2 nonreaction without a stated or proved reactivity relation.
A nontrivial side-swap orbit is treated as the source's comparative 'more symmetrical than PL1' condition without formalizing PL1 or proving a comparison.
Changing an unconstrained Handedness value and obtaining a different list is treated as proving molecular chirality and nonsuperimposable enantiomers.
